rule: Only Weather Mother is presented as the public work platform.
navigation: Weather Mother Home, World, Rain, Fog, Snow, Cloud and Storm remain available through persistent navigation inside one master shell.
directModuleBehavior: Legacy and convenience module paths return the user to the Weather Mother shell with the requested module selected, except explicitly marked internal research pages.
branding: A module may display its short name and version inside the shell. It cannot present itself as another Mother or as a separate public platform.
quality: Each module keeps independent visual, AAA and production gates. A shared shell does not approve an unfinished module.
